ALTER PROC [OM].[SP_UPDATE_PROCESS_DATE_CCD] AS


	BEGIN

		DECLARE @FLAG_SUCC_CNT [NUMERIC](15,0)
		DECLARE @MFLAG_SUCC_CNT [NUMERIC](15,0)
		DECLARE @FLAG_TASK_CNT [NUMERIC](15,0)
		DECLARE @MFLAG_TASK_CNT [NUMERIC](15,0)
		DECLARE @NEXT_PROCESS_DATE [datetime]
		DECLARE @FLAG_INIT_CNT [NUMERIC](15,0)
		DECLARE @ME_FLAG_CNT [NUMERIC](15,0)
	

		
		
		SELECT 
			@FLAG_INIT_CNT=COUNT(*)				
		FROM 
			(SELECT TOP 1 TASK_NAME FROM OM.OM_TASK_RUN WHERE TASK_NAME like '%CCD%') OTR
		
				

		SELECT 
			@FLAG_SUCC_CNT=COUNT(*),
			@NEXT_PROCESS_DATE=MAX(DD.FULLDATE)
		FROM 
			EDS.EDS_CTL EC
		INNER JOIN
			EDS.DATE_DIM DD
			ON
			EC.CCD_DATE=DD.PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY
			AND 
            DD.business_day_flag = 'Y'
		INNER JOIN
			OM.OM_TASK_RUN OTR
			ON
			DD.FULLDATE=OTR.PROCESS_DATE
		INNER JOIN
			OM.OM_TASKS OT
			ON
			OT.TASK_NAME=OTR.TASK_NAME
			AND OT.SOURCE_CODE='CCD'
		INNER JOIN
			OM.OM_STATUS OS
			ON
			OS.STATUS_ID=OTR.STATUS_ID
		WHERE
			OS.STATUS='SUCCESSFUL'
			AND OT.TASK_NAME IN ('TSK_EDS_CCD_CUSTOMER','TSK_EDS_CCD_CARDS','TSK_EDS_CCD_ACCOUNTS','TSK_EDS_CCD_CREDIT_CARDS_FACT')

		
		SELECT 
			@FLAG_TASK_CNT=COUNT(*) 
		FROM 
			OM.OM_TASKS OT
		WHERE
			OT.SOURCE_CODE='CCD'
			AND OT.TASK_NAME IN ('TSK_EDS_CCD_CUSTOMER','TSK_EDS_CCD_CARDS','TSK_EDS_CCD_ACCOUNTS','TSK_EDS_CCD_CREDIT_CARDS_FACT')

			
		SELECT 
			@MFLAG_TASK_CNT=COUNT(*) 
		FROM 
			OM.OM_TASKS OT
		WHERE
			OT.SOURCE_CODE='CCD'
			AND COALESCE(OT.MONTHEND,'N')='Y'
			
		SELECT  
			@ME_FLAG_CNT=COUNT(*)  
		FROM 
			[EDS].[DATE_DIM] 
		WHERE 
			FULLDATE=@NEXT_PROCESS_DATE 
			AND COALESCE(MONTH_END,'N')='Y'
			
			
		IF(@ME_FLAG_CNT>0)   
		BEGIN
			SELECT 
				@MFLAG_SUCC_CNT=COUNT(*)
			FROM 
				EDS.EDS_CTL EC
			INNER JOIN
				EDS.DATE_DIM DD
				ON
				EC.CCD_DATE=DD.PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY
				AND 
				DD.business_day_flag = 'Y'
			INNER JOIN
				OM.OM_TASK_RUN OTR
				ON
				DD.FULLDATE=OTR.PROCESS_DATE
			INNER JOIN
				OM.OM_TASKS OT
				ON
				OT.TASK_NAME=OTR.TASK_NAME
				AND OT.SOURCE_CODE='CCD'
				AND COALESCE(OT.MONTHEND,'N')='Y'
			INNER JOIN
				OM.OM_STATUS OS
				ON
				OS.STATUS_ID=OTR.STATUS_ID
			WHERE
				OS.STATUS='SUCCESSFUL'

			
			SELECT 
				--@FLAG_TASK_CNT=COUNT(*) 
				*
			FROM 
				OM.OM_TASKS OT
			WHERE
				OT.SOURCE_CODE='CCD'
				AND OT.SCHEMA_NAME = 'EDS' --ADDED RTSF 09/18/2024
				
			IF(@MFLAG_SUCC_CNT<>@MFLAG_TASK_CNT)
				BEGIN
					--RAISERROR('CURRENT BUSINESS DATE STATUS IS NOT YET SUCCESSFUL FOR ALL CCD JOBS. PLEASE CHECK OM.OM_TASK_RUN AND EDS.EDS_CTL TABLE', 16,1)
					THROW 50001, 'CURRENT BUSINESS DATE STATUS IS NOT YET SUCCESSFUL FOR ALL CCD JOBS. PLEASE CHECK OM.OM_TASK_RUN AND EDS.EDS_CTL TABLE', 1;
				END		
		
		END

	

		IF(@FLAG_SUCC_CNT<>@FLAG_TASK_CNT AND @FLAG_INIT_CNT>0)
			BEGIN
				--RAISERROR('CURRENT BUSINESS DATE STATUS IS NOT YET SUCCESSFUL FOR ALL CCD JOBS. PLEASE CHECK OM.OM_TASK_RUN AND EDS.EDS_CTL TABLE', 16,1)
				THROW 50001, 'CURRENT BUSINESS DATE STATUS IS NOT YET SUCCESSFUL FOR ALL CCD JOBS. PLEASE CHECK OM.OM_TASK_RUN AND EDS.EDS_CTL TABLE', 1;
			END
			
		IF(@NEXT_PROCESS_DATE IS NULL)
			BEGIN
				--RAISERROR('NO NEXT BUSINESS DATE RETRIEVED FROM EDS.DATE_DIM, OM.OM_TASK_RUN AND EDS.EDS_CTL TABLE', 16,1)
				THROW 50002, 'NO NEXT BUSINESS DATE RETRIEVED FROM EDS.DATE_DIM, OM.OM_TASK_RUN AND EDS.EDS_CTL TABLE', 1; 
			END
			
		UPDATE [EDS].[EDS_CTL] SET CCD_DATE=@NEXT_PROCESS_DATE

	END
GO
